guide.hearthholm.ch1.title: Founding
guide.hearthholm.ch1.p1: Craft a Town Hall Desk (plank, paper, plank / log, crafting table, log / log, -, log) and place it: the settlement is founded and this book is yours. The desk is the heart of the town. Right-click it to hire settlers, mint hearth marks and read your progress. Two settlements cannot start within 24 blocks of each other.
guide.hearthholm.ch1.p2: First steps: build a house (a closed room with a roof, a door and a bed), set up a warehouse (a Warehouse Ledger in a closed room with chests), then hire your first settler. The Overview tab always names the next step. Hold any Hearthholm item to see zone outlines.
guide.hearthholm.ch2.title: Hiring
guide.hearthholm.ch2.p1: Right-click the desk and open Hire: three candidates, each with traits and an aptitude (stars) for every profession. Hiring costs food from the warehouse or your pockets (10, plus 5 for each settler already living here) and needs a free bed. Right-click a settler to pick a profession.
guide.hearthholm.ch2.p2: Population is capped by tier: camp 2, hamlet 5, village 10, town 16, city 24. Settlers have moods. Tasty meals, festivals, a beautiful street and friends raise it; quarrels and raid losses lower it. Unhappy settlers may leave. Level up a profession by working at it.
guide.hearthholm.ch3.title: Houses
guide.hearthholm.ch3.p1: A room is a closed space with a roof and a door. Beds turn it into a house: one bed per settler. The Buildings tab shows every room and says why one is not counted (no door, open roof, too small). Comfort grows with light and decor.
guide.hearthholm.ch3.p2: The warehouse is a closed room with a Warehouse Ledger and chests. Settlers carry all goods there and take food, tools and materials from it. The first time each kind of room is found it pays renown, so build variety.
guide.hearthholm.ch4.title: Work sites
guide.hearthholm.ch4.p1: Place a marker (2 sticks + an item): mine (cobblestone), forest (sapling), farm (seeds), fishing (string), patrol post (iron), territory banner (wool), construction stake (paper). Right-click it to configure it. A chest nearby receives the haul.
guide.hearthholm.ch4.p2: The builder follows blueprints or a free plan, the miner digs a spiral, tunnel or shaft, the lumberjack fells and replants, the farmer sows and harvests, the fisher fishes, the guard patrols. Shift+right-click a settler holding a tool, armor or food to hand it over.
guide.hearthholm.ch5.title: Workshops
guide.hearthholm.ch5.p1: A carpenter's bench, mason's table, smith's anvil or kitchen stove in a closed room with a door makes a workshop with its own crafter. Masons and smiths need a furnace in the room. Crafters use vanilla recipes and burn fuel from the warehouse when smelting or cooking.
guide.hearthholm.ch5.p2: The Order Board sets standing orders ("keep 64 planks") and shows what blocks each one. Carpenters, masons and smiths can also make street decor: kegs, benches, counters, lamp posts, wells and signs. Mint hearth marks at the desk from surplus goods; marks pay for trade, promotions and more.
guide.hearthholm.ch6.title: Tiers
guide.hearthholm.ch6.p1: Renown grows with work, new buildings, won raids and festivals. Tiers: camp 0, hamlet 60, village 300, town 1000, city 3000. A tier above camp also needs a valid town hall and warehouse. Higher tiers raise the population cap and the settlement radius.
guide.hearthholm.ch6.p2: Tiers unlock blueprints for the construction stake. Hamlet: workshop, farmhouse. Village: tavern, market stall, watchtower. Town: barracks, wall section. Locked plans are greyed out and refused by the server. The caravan trader sells plans early.
guide.hearthholm.ch7.title: Town life
guide.hearthholm.ch7.p1: A tavern is a room with a Tavern Keg and an innkeeper. In the evening off-duty settlers gather there and a hot supper lifts their mood. Every 7 days a trader with a llama comes to the market for a day: sell surplus for marks, buy seeds, saplings, plans and rare hires.
guide.hearthholm.ch7.p2: The Bulletin Board offers three requests a day: bring items, or clear pests near a work site. Rewards are marks, renown or gifts. Lamp posts, benches, flower boxes and signs near settlers give the Beautiful street mood. The settlement banner accepts dyes.
guide.hearthholm.ch8.title: Defense
guide.hearthholm.ch8.p1: From the hamlet tier, Ashborn raiders strike at dusk every 5 to 8 days after 3 calm days; they grow with your wealth and people. A horn and a timer warn you 60 seconds ahead. Ring the Alarm Bell: civilians hide, fighters gather. Palisades and gates slow raiders; the Defense tab shows the next raid.
guide.hearthholm.ch8.p2: On Rift nights a Rift opens at the border and spits monsters. Break its core with a pickaxe for Rift shards: they make the Rift Lantern, which keeps monsters away. From the town tier the Ash Chieftain leads raids. Arsonists burn palisades, gates, doors and fences, not roofs.
guide.hearthholm.ch9.title: Retinue
guide.hearthholm.ch9.p1: Craft and use a War Horn: up to 4 nearby fighters (guard, warrior, archer, knight) follow you, teleport when left behind and fight your enemies. Use it again to send them home. Archers need bows and arrows in the warehouse. Healers tend the wounded and brew salves at the herbalist table.
guide.hearthholm.ch9.p2: Guards and warriors of level 5 can become knights (10 marks + iron armor): a shield, more health and a taunt that pulls raiders onto them. Wounded fighters rest in the barracks, a room with a weapon rack. Below 30% health they retreat. Good luck, founder!
